title: The Analytic Non-Triviality Theorem for Schur-Tared Fredholm Divisors on Kähler Manifolds: Resolving the Trivial-Zero Obstruction via Heat-Kernel Index Theory and Holomorphic Rigidity
description: Formal Lean 4 machine-certified proof and numerical verification of the Analytic Non-Triviality Theorem, establishing that regularized Schur-tared Fredholm determinants cannot vanish identically, resolving the trivial-zero obstruction in algebraic cycle extraction. In this work, ai is being used as a tool to assist in formal verification, symbol auditing, and manuscript preparation.
